news.title: Incredible World Cup hero is coming to Liverpool
news.lede: An incredible wonderkid is coming to Liverpool who has become a World Cup hero for his country.The Julian Ward era has begun at Anfield. There's hope that it will be as fruitful as the promise shown by his predecessor, Richard Hughes.Liverpool have invested in their future over the last few years. The Reds have surrendered immediate success for a long-term vision buying future superstars in order to shed their veterans and build an exciting young squad.Hughes' strategy involved buying some of the best young players on the market. Florian Wirtz, Jeremy Jacquet, Hugo Ekitike, Milos Kerkez and Bradley Barcola all fall into that category.They have subsequently become the foundations for this current Liverpool team.

news.title: FIFA to visit potential 2030 World Cup host cities in November and December
news.lede: A general view shows construction works of the Hassan II Stadium, ahead of the World Cup, in Benslimane, near Casablanca, Morocco, May 23, 2026. Picture taken with a mobile phone. Oct 27 - FIFA will carry out a series of visits to candidate host cities in Spain, Portugal and Morocco in November and December as part of the venue selection process for the 2030 World Cup, world football's governing body said on Tuesday. A FIFA delegation will visit candidate cities and stadiums in all three host countries to assess their suitability to host games.
